serverInfo.name: INDEPENDENT ELECTRIC BIKES
serverInfo.description: Independent Australian retailer of electric bikes, scooters, skateboards, unicycles, mobility scooters and personal EVs, with parts and accessories. Brunswick, Victoria.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search products (e-bikes, scooters, skateboards, unicycles, mobility scooters, parts and accessories) by keyword query, category slug, or max_price in AUD

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get details and pricing for a single product by slug. Specifications are included only where verified against the manufacturer

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all shop categories (e-bikes, scooters, skateboards, self-balancing EVs, kids and off-road EVs, mobility scooters, batteries and parts, safety and carry, quads, water sports) with product counts

tools.name: get_policies
tools.description: Get express shipping rules, warranty policies, minimum order ($350 AUD), and payment options (Bank Transfer, PayID, 10% Crypto discount)

tools.name: create_order_draft
tools.description: Create a prefilled order draft with WhatsApp and Checkout URL. Human customer completes the transaction.

legal.productType: Electric Bikes, Scooters, Skateboards, Personal EVs, Parts & Accessories
legal.compliance: Compliance and road rules vary by vehicle type and Australian state. See each product page and the FAQ.
